newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Santos workers return after 2-hour stoppage.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Santos workers return after 2-hour stoppage.

text.p: Stevedores at Brazil's key Santos port returned to work as expected at 1900 local/2200 GMT after a two-hour stoppage while they attended a demonstration in the city center, a port spokesman said.
"Everything is working normally again," the spokesman said.
The stevedores were protesting against a deadlock in talks with steel firm Companhia Siderurgica Paulista (Cosipa) following a strike last week.

Twenty-six stevedores have been occupying two vessels at Cosipa's private terminal at the port in protest against the firm's decision to use its own workers to conduct loading and unloading at the terminal.
A judge at the Sao Paulo Regional Labor Tribunal has ordered the military police to evacuate the workers.

But the stevedores have said they will immediately call a national port strike if the police try to remove the protestors or if Cosipa allowed any new vessles to dock at the terminal or tried to use its own workers.
